text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap asked me to meet up with her
for some
cardio training before the race,
but to my
surprise...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama and Inari told me that the scary
rides are
the perfect way to train
yourself up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The excitement of a roller coaster will
surely
strengthen my heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I suspect that this training
won't be of
much help, I decide to go
along with her plan all
the same.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's like I'm flying. Going this fast is
shaking me to
my core... My heart isn't
the only thing getting a
workout here...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Where am I? I thought I was on a
roller
coaster.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Are those the Three Goddesses over
there?
They look like they're doing a
festival dance.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I wonder if the dance helps you
get
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So... you sway from side to side as you
break
away from the group, spin around,
and then
speed up as you go around the
bend.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Those who dance well, race well." Is
that it? You
might be onto something
there, Goddesses...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was in a strange meadow somewhere
watching
the Three Goddesses doing a
festival dance.
choice_data_list: もしかして意識飛んでた？
choice_data_list_en: Did you zone out for a second?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So I resolutely danced back at them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I felt so much power flowing throughout
my body.
I've definitely grown stronger
from it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a confident smile on her face,
Oguri Cap
looks like twice the racer she
was before.
